test_title: SSC MTS Previous Year Paper (Held on: 14 Oct 2021 Shift 1)
subject: general
question: A certain sum amounts to Rs. 29,282 in 4 years at 10% p.a. when the interest is compounded yearly. What is the simple interest (in Rs.) on double of the sum for five years’ time at the same rate?
solution:
**Given:**

Amount in 4 years at 10% per annum = Rs.29282 

**Formulas used:**

Amount on compound interest (compounded yearly)

P × (1 + r/100)ⁿ

Simple Interest = P × Rate/100 × Time 

**Calculation:**

Rs.29282 = P × (1 + 10/100)⁴

⇒ 29282 = P × 14641/10000 

⇒ P = 29282 × 10000/14641 

⇒ P = 20000 

Simple interest at double the sum for 5 years at 10% p.a:

⇒ 2 × 20000 × 5 × 10/100 

⇒ 20000

**∴ The required simple interest is Rs.20000. **

** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] __Additional Information__**Amount for 10% interest = 10 + 1 = 11 units

The total amount for 4 years

⇒ 11 × 11 × 11 × 11 = 14641 units = Rs. 29282

⇒ 1 unit = Rs. 2

Principal = 10 × 10 × 10 × 10 = 10000 units 

Principal = Rs. 2 × 100000 = Rs. 20000

Interest = (20000 × 2 × 5 × 10)/100 = Rs. 20000

∴ The interest is Rs. 20000.
